contents.text: What was Microsoft's total stockholders' equity?

Microsoft's total stockholders' equity was $442,387 million as of June 30, 2026 (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA > STOCKHOLDERS’ EQUITY STATEMENTS).
